text:
Question: After we got the A5 visa in the passport and at the same time applied to get a new Israeli Teudat Zehut, how long does it take till Bituach Leumi is updated?  Or, do I need to have the physical Teudat Zehut with us and go to the Bituach Leumi office?

We need to have the Kupat Cholim registration and until this is sorted out at the Bituach Leumi, we are still "without status". So is this done automatically? manually and do we need to do anything to update Bituach Leumi about the status change to A5?

Thanks for any input.
